name: branding-dog-mark-on-quilted-lime-harness-and-spotted-fur
title: Dog mark shown on a lime pet jacket label and hidden in Dalmatian fur
whatItIs: A white slide with the solid dog symbol and ®, below it two photos: a small dog in a quilted lime jacket with a woven tag carrying the mark, and a macro of Dalmatian fur where the black mark blends among the spots.
whatItMeans: Witty and affectionate; the logo camouflaged in spots shows the brand's cleverness.
techniques: Hide the logo inside a natural pattern.
Apply a one-colour mark to a small woven tag.
Use a lime garment as the only colour.
bestFor: Marks that can blend with patterns

vocabulary.definition: A logo hidden inside a pattern.
A fabric label sewn into clothing.
One colour used as the only hue.
